articles.title: CLARITY will strengthen dollar stablecoins, but Asia wins on yield: HashKey Research
articles.snippet: HashKey says U.S. regulatory clarity may unlock institutional adoption of crypto and reinforce USD stablecoins globally, though stricter yield rules could push capital toward Asian markets offering higher returns.

articles.title: Australia’s proposed CGT changes could discourage long-term crypto holding
articles.snippet: Robin Singh, CEO and founder of Koinly said the changes will hurt low-income crypto investors most and could encourage more short-term trading.

articles.title: Kimi WebBridge Lets AI Agents Drive Your Browser—And Keep Your Data Local
articles.snippet: Moonshot AI just shipped a browser extension that hands the wheel to AI agents. It clicks, scrolls, fills forms, and navigates your Chrome or Edge—without sessions ever leaving your machine.
